content.comment_body: Hello, I have a [product_name] with article number [article_no], which I can successfully ping from my PC and vice versa. However, when I try to upload or download a program, the wizard closes unexpectedly without displaying any error. When attempting to access [product_name] online, I get a message indicating: "The connected base module does not support network communication." I switched [product_name] to Admin mode and tried adjusting the network speed to 10Mbps based on advice from other help topics, but communication still does not work. PC IP: 192.168.1.10 - Subnet Mask: 255.255.255.0 [product_name] IP: 192.168.1.23 Any assistance is appreciated.

Hello [user_name], It seems you are using [product_name] software [version_no]. Your hardware is [product_name] with [article_no] and [version_no]. You need to update your software to [version_no]. You can get the update from [document] for demo versions, upgrades/updates, or drivers. Best regards, [user_name]
The issue was indeed related to the software version. Thanks a lot for your help!

analysis.insight_summary: The core issue reported was an inability to establish network communication between the user's PC and [product_name], preventing program uploads and downloads. The user received an error message stating that the connected base module does not support network communication. The fundamental UX challenge stemmed from software version incompatibility, which caused unexpected behavior and a lack of clear error feedback until the specific network communication error appeared.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipated hassle-free program uploads and downloads over the network using the appropriate [company_name] software, without encountering errors related to unsupported device communication.
